**The Limitations of Traditional Enterprise Sales Strategies**

Enterprise sales strategy often relies on generic outreach and lead generation tactics, resulting in a mere 5% conversion rate for cold outreach efforts. In contrast, Elesium's signal-driven model has been shown to cut time-to-first-meeting from an average of 90 days to under 14 days, with over 70% of introductions leading to a qualified first conversation.

"The average sales cycle for B2B deals is 102 days, with 60% of deals stalling due to a lack of buyer engagement." - [Source: HubSpot's 2026 Sales Enablement Report](https://www.hubspot.com/sales-enablement-report)

Our proprietary signal identifies buyers with an active mandate, reducing the time-to-first-meeting and increasing the likelihood of a successful partnership. This approach has resulted in an OEM supplier in the mid-market segment reducing their average sales cycle by over 60% after Elesium facilitated three verified introductions to procurement directors within their target vertical.

By leveraging revenue operations software and B2B partnership programs, enterprises can streamline their sales processes and focus on high-ticket opportunities. Elesium's platform provides a data-driven approach to identifying and engaging with verified buyers, resulting in a significant reduction in customer acquisition costs and an increase in revenue growth.
